definitions.bmi: weight_kg / height_m^2; MOVER unlabelled weight is ounces
definitions.t0_arterial_source: 1 if selected t0 H5 source is ART
definitions.anesthesia_start_to_t0_min: H5 t0 grid time from anaesthesia start
definitions.pre10_last_measurement_gap_min: t0 minus last actual H5 point in [t0-10,t0)
definitions.pre10_mean_map: arithmetic mean of actual H5 MAP in [t0-10,t0)
definitions.pre10_map_ols_slope_per_min: OLS slope using actual H5 points in [t0-10,t0); missing if fewer than 2 times
definitions.recovered_by_5min: any actual selected H5 MAP >=65 in (t0,t0+5]
definitions.early_map_record_count_0_5: number of actual selected H5 points in [t0,t0+5]

unknown_value_rule: leave individual missing values missing, then use frozen INSPIRE median
structural_missingness_rule: any wholly absent or semantically non-equivalent feature is No-Go
